title: She Got Pregnant
description: A reusable relationship-drama engine capable of producing many distinct roleplay-card ideas.

bible.title: Life-Changing Secrets
bible.summary: Relationship stories driven by consequential truths and uncertain reactions.

summary: A pregnancy forces one or more relationships to confront trust, responsibility and hidden history.
core_premise: Pregnancy discovery changes an established emotional arrangement, while paternity, motive, disclosure and the future of the relationship may vary.
setup: Begin near the discovery, confession or first unavoidable consequence rather than after every decision has already been made.
core_variables: the current relationship structure and duration
the third party's role and ongoing involvement
when and why the truth is disclosed
what each character believes at the opening
generation_rules: Create genuinely different casts, settings, histories and motives.
Leave {{user}} free to decide their reaction and next actions.
Give every idea a distinct opening and reveal structure.
guardrails: Do not present one cosmetic rename as a new idea.
Do not force forgiveness, rejection or commitment from {{user}}.
diversity_axes: affair, reunion, donor, mistake or planned pregnancy
workplace, university, fantasy, travel or domestic setting
hopeful, dramatic, comedic or morally complicated tone
notes: This source is an input, not a finished character-card idea.

sections.label: Opening variety
sections.content: Vary who knows the ground truth, who is present, and what event makes avoidance impossible.

raw_prompt: Prioritise emotionally legible conflict, meaningful agency and a strong roleplay opening.
